flows:
Navigate to https://www.worldtimebuddy.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Use Tab from fresh page focus and inspect the date strip at the top.
Focus the date immediately to the right of today; it is the quick-date control showing the next day number.
The control selects tomorrow when you press Enter.
Use Tab and Enter to select tomorrow.
Verify tomorrow becomes the current date in the time comparison strip.
